programme.desc: The Bellyache Mystery ‐ It appears that the Sea Monster has EATEN Quasi! Naughty seamonster.., whilst PK and Ra are set the task of trying to get Quasi out of there, Casper’s convinced Quasi is elsewhere and sets off to find him – his main clue being a pair of ballet slippers! Goodbye Jimmy ‐ Graham is fed up. He’s convinced he’ll never be a successful ghost catcher if they stay in Deedstown so the family start to make plans to move – to SCOTLAND! Poor Jimmy is horrified. He will never get to hang out with his best friend Casper again. Casper rounds up the ghostly troops and gives a ghostly display to fantastic that Graham shelves the moving plan and takes down the ‘for sale’ sign!

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: The Poltergeist Assignment ‐ Today Frankegymteacher is teaching the Scare School kids the basics of telekinesis – the black art of moving objects around just by thinking about it. FGT then assigns a different house in Deedstown to each kid so that they can practice frightening the fleshie residents with their new powers. Thatch is assigned Jimmy’s house, and has a hard time escaping from Graham! Whilst Casper is at an old lady’s house, and of course he can’t bear to scare the old dear. But Casper will have to do SOMETHING as they are watched by the gargoyles AND there’s the added problem of a mysterious garden gnome thief seemingly running wild… The Little Dragon ‐ It’s show and tell in science class. Rooting about in the Secret Attic Casper finds a dragon egg and brings it to Prof. Burns’ class. The teacher is thrilled! He’s not seen a dragon’s egg in 600 years! and he fetches the headmasters. The dragon’s birth is imminent, all are on tenderhooks!. Thatch sneakily steals the egg but loses it by accident. Professor Burns is furious! Casper and his friends must find the egg as soon as possible because if it does hatch and if the dragon eats something sweet, it will grow to GIGANTIC proportions and become a city destroying BEAST!! Casper must prevent a disaster from happening in Deedstown.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School

Luckily, Casper’s nose is blocked by a cold so he is the only student immune to the perfume’s spell! He is also the only one who can fix his mistake! programme.desc: Dulcinea pulls a magical sword from a stone and becomes enchanted with heroic powers; Puss must help her learn how to control her newfound strength.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go!
programme.desc: When Tag is left in charge of the Pawston Pawtomotive for the day, Frank and Beans open up a rival garage and take all the business. But when all the cars around Pawston break down because of Frank's shoddy mechanic work, Tag and Scooch have to go around town to fix all his mistakes. \ Scooch wants to be a Tail-kwondo master like his hero, Master Wag, but he can't break a biscuit with his tail. Tag helps train him (and his tail), and they even track down Master Wag who gives Scooch a good luck charm. But when Scooch loses the good luck charm before his tail-kwondo test, he needs to find a way to believe in himself.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: Accidental Hero In order to win the Fright Stuff Award, Casper consults his uncles for scaring advice. Rich Kid Ra When Ra pulls up to Scare School in a solid gold chariot, everyone suddenly wants to be his best friend.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: Dragon Quest The unlucky staff of a medieval-themed restaurant in Deedstown, get an unfriendly visit from Professor Thurdigree Burns. Opposite Day When Wolfie's experiment with moonlight goes awry, everyone but Casper turns into his or her opposite.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go
programme.desc: When Rodney heads to the Community Center for Junior Security Cadet picture day, TZG secretly helps him stay neat and clean for the photo shoot. / When Luis worries about his first ever math test, TZG secretly helps steady his nerves.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go
programme.desc: New girl in town Felicia shows off her robo-dog but it runs out of control, and TZG must secretly stop the barking bot from wreaking havoc. / When Lula starts gathering birthday wishes from folks around town, TZG secretly keeps her surprise party under wraps.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Olivia finds the perfect birthday present for Francine in a box of cereal – a pink charm bracelet! But when it accidentally falls down the drain, Olivia has to scramble to find an alternative: using trinkets that recall some of their favorite memories together, Olivia makes her own charm bracelet for a delighted Francine.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Olivia is thrilled when she’s chosen to build the mascot snowman –or in her case, snowlady – for the annual Maywood winter festival. She’s determined to build the biggest snowman anybody’s ever seen! But when all the snow melts away, Olivia has to build her snowlady out of something else: cotton candy!

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: When Olivia’s Mom gets sick, Olivia steps into her shoes and helps plan a tea party. And not just any old tea party – this is a pirate tea party! It’s not quite what the client had in mind, but in the end they have to admit: there’s never been a tea party as much fun as Olivia’s!

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Olivia is disappointed when she hurts her leg on the eve of her big tap dance recital. But the show must go on! Taking inspiration from her baby brother William’s rolling walker, she builds herself a fanciful apparatus – the tip top tapper – so that she can dance as scheduled. Thanks to her new invention, her performance is a hit!

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: Cheese! ‐ Casper asks his uncle Stinky to fix Mantha’s ‘polaroid’ camera – they’ve got a ‘fear’ test and she wanted to take photos of frightened things for the test. As they struggle to fix the camera, Casper accidentally takes a picture of his uncle, who inexplicably disappears and finds himself locked inside the picture! What on EARTH is happening? Casper has to make things right – and as soon as possible so Mantha doesn’t fail her test. Thatch realizes what the camera is doing, steals it and sets to take a photograph everyone in Scare School, hoping to trap them forever inside the little photographs and stick them in a big book of captured monsters! Casper must save the day before EVERYONE winds up in the spooky photo album evil Thatch is concocting.. Casper’s New Friend ‐ Casper accidentally frees ‘’Goo The Giggling Ghoul’’ from a vial in the science lab. Goo’s a super friendly ghost who races off to wreak (friendly) havoc in Deedstown. Goo was actually the result of one of Professor Burns failed experiments – and was never meant to be let out of the jar! ‐ so Casper must bring him back to School before the Headmasters banish Casper himself from School ‐ not to mention that Goo is a serious menace to the Balance of Fear!
